title: Evaluation of MRI anatomy in machine learning predictive models to assess hydrogel spacer benefit for prostate cancer patients
summary: The primary Methods and Results describe retrospective comparison of planning-CT and diagnostic-MRI inputs for dose/toxicity machine-learning models in the 20 most recent eligible prostate-radiotherapy patients; the reported model accuracies were similar.
